Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥7,005 million (up 2.0% year on year), and segment profit was ¥661 million (down 2.6% year on year). Segment profit was affected by the gross profit margin falling below the previous year, although profit improvement progressed. entries.979c57895d47b1fc: A reportable segment based in Japan, and the one with the larger operating revenue from external customers of the 2 reportable segments. It is handled by the Company and its domestic consolidated subsidiary Nisshin Unyu Co., Ltd., to which import and export customs clearance operations and warehouse work in Japan are outsourced. For the fiscal year ended February 2026, operating revenue was ¥49,731 million (up 5.5% year on year) and segment profit was ¥3,359 million (up 5.5%). The securities report states that operating revenue increased because the year began with freight rates at a high level due to the rise in ocean freight rates from around summer of the previous fiscal year, and because the number of customs clearance orders increased to 152,656 (up 9.6% year on year) and the number of containers handled in ocean freight transport increased to 256,851 TEU in total for exports and imports (up 3.2%). Segment profit increased due to improved gross profit from price pass-through and restrained selling, general and administrative expenses.
